Дали мора да користам AI?: Do I have to use AI?
Не. SQL прашањата, графиконите и контрол: No. SQL queries, charts and dashboards work without AI. For AI features, choose Ollama and download a model, or enter your own API key in Settings → AI Configuration. Review generated queries and results.
Апликацијата и метаподатоците се на ваша: The application and metadata live on your infrastructure. Bi-Dash queries your connected sources. If you choose an external AI provider, AI requests are sent to that provider under its policies.
Може ли целиот тим да го користи?: Can my whole team use it?
Да, со соодветна серверска конфигурација: Yes, with an appropriate server configuration. The local setup listens on 127.0.0.1:5001. For company access, configure HTTPS, networking, permissions and backups. The Linux guide describes private access through an SSH tunnel.
